semantic_checklist.lean_evidence: The target binds q : Real → Real → Real and speed x t : Real; its explicit system dimension is 1.
semantic_checklist.reasoning: Currying and the singleton-vector representation preserve the mathematical types and dimension.

semantic_checklist.source_evidence: The sentence introducing (1.2) asserts that the concentration or density of the transported contaminant satisfies the displayed equation.
